en_title: Hideo Kojima Reveals What Happened With Sony in Exclusive First Interview Since PlayStation Ditched Physint
subtitle: 另寻出路
opus_summary: 索尼6月撤回《Physint》资金，小岛秀夫一度担心小岛工作室断流倒闭。他向XBOX提案后，项目获接手并继续开发；工作室称与PlayStation关系稳固。

paragraphs.en: In June, Sony asked Hideo Kojima to attend a Zoom call. At the time, he was busy working on Xbox game OD and PlayStation game Physint , the latter a spiritual successor to the video game series that made him one of the most celebrated developers on the planet: Metal Gear Solid.
paragraphs.cn: 6月，索尼要求小岛秀夫参加一场Zoom会议。当时，他正忙于开发XBOX游戏《OD》和PlayStation游戏《Physint》；后者是《潜龙谍影》的精神续作，而这个系列也让他成为全球最受推崇的开发者之一。

paragraphs.en: For the meeting, he brought along Kojima Productions president Shinji Hirano and head of talent development Aki Saito. Kojima tells IGN in his first interview since last week’s dramatic news that he was so stunned by what Sony told him that his mind went blank. PlayStation was pulling out of the Physint project, and funding for it would end. And that was that.
paragraphs.cn: 参加会议时，他带上了小岛工作室总裁Shinji Hirano和人才培养主管Aki Saito。小岛秀夫在上周爆炸性新闻后的首次采访中告诉IGN，他被索尼告知的消息震惊到大脑一片空白。PlayStation将退出《Physint》项目，并终止对该项目的资助。事情就这么定了。

paragraphs.en: Kojima initially kept the news from his staff at Kojima Productions as he worried over the future of his company. Would he have to let developers from the Physint team go? Would they leave anyway, given what had happened? What would the bank, whose loans helped Kojima Productions staff up after the release of Death Stranding, think? And what about all the actors he’d already scanned for Physint? Was this a P.T. situation all over again?
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫起初没有把这个消息告诉小岛工作室的员工，因为他正为工作室的未来发愁。他是否得解雇《Physint》团队的开发者？即使他不这么做，他们会不会也因这件事而离开？《死亡搁浅》发售后，曾帮助小岛工作室扩充人员的银行贷款又该怎么办？那些已经为《Physint》扫描过的演员呢？这会不会又重演一次《P.T.》的情况？

paragraphs.en: As we know, Kojima convinced Microsoft and new Xbox boss Asha Sharma to pick up Physint in one of the most dramatic console switches in history. Now the previous PlayStation exclusive may not release on PlayStation at all.
paragraphs.cn: 如今我们知道，小岛秀夫说服微软和XBOX新负责人Asha Sharma接手《Physint》，完成了游戏主机史上最戏剧性的阵营转换之一。这款原本由PlayStation独占的游戏，如今甚至可能完全不会登陆PlayStation。

paragraphs.en: In our interview, Kojima tells IGN Japan’s Daniel Robson how he feared Kojima Productions might collapse as a result of Sony's decision, and details his game-saving pitch to Xbox, which was quick to snap Physint up.
paragraphs.cn: 在采访中，小岛秀夫向IGN日本的Daniel Robson讲述了他如何担心小岛工作室会因索尼的决定而倒闭，也详述了他为挽救游戏向XBOX提出的方案。XBOX很快便接手了《Physint》。

paragraphs.en: It’s important to note that the interview was conducted before Bloomberg’s report that Sony ditched Physint due to missed deadlines, budget concerns, and Death Stranding’s alleged commercial failings . Kojima Productions provided a statement to IGN, which appears at the end of this interview, following a request for comment. In it, Kojima Productions insists the studio is "in a healthy, profitable state, development for Physint continues to move forward with Xbox, and our relationship with PlayStation remains strong.​"
paragraphs.cn: 需要指出的是，本次采访完成于彭博社发布报道之前。彭博社称，索尼放弃《Physint》的原因包括项目错过截止期限、预算方面的担忧，以及《死亡搁浅》据称商业表现不佳。IGN就此寻求置评后，小岛工作室向IGN提供了一份声明，声明刊于本次采访末尾。声明坚称：「工作室目前运营健康且实现盈利，《Physint》的开发正与XBOX合作推进，我们与PlayStation的关系依然稳固。」

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: We are an independent company, so no funding is behind us as a corporation. We sign contracts according to projects, and that's how we survive one by one as an indie. So I need to find a new project before the previous project ends, and that's how we stay alive. That's our background situation.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：我们是一家独立公司，背后没有企业资金支持。我们按项目签订合约，作为独立工作室，只能靠一个个项目维持生存。因此，上一个项目结束前，我必须找到下一个项目，这就是我们活下去的方式。这就是我们的基本处境。

paragraphs.en: So in June, SIE said they wanted to have a Zoom call. I was so busy at that time — I had just gone to New York for a Prada event and then to LA right after. But anyway, I came back and we had this Zoom call.
paragraphs.cn: 6月，索尼互动娱乐（SIE）表示想通过Zoom开会。我当时非常忙，刚去纽约出席Prada活动，紧接着又去了洛杉矶。不过，我回来后还是参加了那场Zoom会议。

paragraphs.en: They said they can no longer fund development for Physint. I was shocked and I said, "What did you say?" I couldn’t quite process what they had said. I wasn’t sure because I was in shock.
paragraphs.cn: 他们说，无法再资助《Physint》的开发。我很震惊，问道：「你说什么？」我一时没能理解他们说的话。因为太过震惊，我甚至不确定自己是否听明白了。

paragraphs.en: Anyway, I know there's a lot of news in the game industry that many studios are closing down, many titles are canceled, and I understand the situation in the industry as a whole. But I thought Physint was okay. That Physint was safe. So I was surprised. But not just surprised. We didn’t understand the reason. I didn't have any anger or sadness; my first thought was, “What am I going to do with my studio?” Because we signed contracts for projects. Of course I had OD, but I only have two projects in my studio: OD and Physint. And I hire according to how many projects we have, and we have two. If we lose one contract, I thought I might have to cut all the people working on Physint, right? Or our studio could end up collapsing because we’ll run out of cashflow.
paragraphs.cn: 总之，我知道游戏行业不断传出许多工作室关闭、许多作品取消的消息，也了解整个行业的处境。但我原以为《Physint》不会有问题，是安全的，所以很惊讶。但不只是惊讶，我们也不明白原因。我没有愤怒或伤心，最先想到的是：「我的工作室怎么办？」因为我们是按项目签合同的。我们当然还有《OD》，但工作室只有《OD》和《Physint》两个项目。我们有几个项目，就按项目数来招人；现在有两个项目。要是少了一份合同，我想，我可能得裁掉所有负责《Physint》的员工，对吧？又或者，整个工作室都可能因现金流耗尽而倒闭。

paragraphs.en: I’ve borrowed money from the bank for funding as well. At first [when we established the studio] they didn't listen to us at all. After a while when we got a title out, they were like, "We'll lend you money." If they find out that a project has been stopped or canceled, we'd be in big trouble. So my mind went blank when SIE told me. I don't remember so much of that meeting, to be honest with you. And my colleagues probably don't remember as well, so I can't really answer if you ask me what exactly they said.
paragraphs.cn: 我也曾为了筹资向银行借钱。最初工作室刚成立时，银行根本不理会我们。后来我们推出一部作品后，他们才说：「我们愿意借钱给你们。」要是他们发现某个项目停止或取消，我们就会有大麻烦。所以索尼互动娱乐告诉我这件事时，我脑子一片空白。坦白说，那场会议的很多内容我已经记不清了。我的同事大概也不记得，因此如果你问我他们当时究竟说了什么，我确实答不上来。

paragraphs.en: Nothing could’ve prepared me for their decision to step away from the project. So I thought, "What am I going to do from tomorrow?" But from my side, I love Sony. And I don't have any bad feelings against them because I know that it's a tough time in the game industry.
paragraphs.cn: 我完全没有料到他们会决定退出这个项目。所以我想：「从明天起我该怎么办？」但就我而言，我很喜欢索尼。我对他们没有任何负面情绪，因为我知道游戏行业正处于艰难时期。

paragraphs.en: I've been working with them for like 30 years… Mr. Ken Kutaragi, Mr. Hirai, I was close with them. But it's not like that recently. I realized that, okay, this is the reality. It's the 10th anniversary of my studio. My studio might collapse, right?
paragraphs.cn: 我和他们共事大约30年了……我和久多良木健先生、平井一夫先生关系很近。但最近已经不是那样了。我意识到，嗯，这就是现实。工作室成立10周年了，我的工作室也可能倒闭，对吧？

paragraphs.en: But the number one priority is my staff. We have about 200 people, and I expanded because we had Physint. They are talented, of course. And some of them came to my studio from big corporations. I warned them it might not be a good idea to do so… But anyways, I needed to protect these important staff. I’ve also begun scanning actors for the project and also speaking with artists about collaborating for Physint. I can't really tell them the game has been canceled. I didn't want to do the same thing we did for P.T. Of course, I didn't want them to worry.
paragraphs.cn: 但首要的是我的员工。我们大约有200人，因为有《Physint》这个项目，我才扩张了团队。他们当然都很有才华，其中一些人还从大企业来到我的工作室。我警告过他们，这么做可能不是个好主意……但无论如何，我得保护这些重要的员工。我也已经开始为这个项目扫描演员，并与艺术家洽谈为《Physint》合作。我实在没法告诉他们游戏已经取消了。我不想再重演《P.T.》那样的事，当然也不想让他们担心。

paragraphs.en: For me personally, it’s the 10th anniversary of the studio and also my 40th anniversary of creating games, so that's why I put so much on Physint. It’s like a culmination of the two. During the pandemic, I was a little unwell and I thought about how much time I have left. I really thought that I would give my all to Physint at this point in my career. I really wanted to continue this project even after that meeting. I was thinking, "What should I do?"
paragraphs.cn: 对我个人而言，今年既是工作室成立10周年，也是我制作游戏40周年，所以我在《Physint》上投入了这么多。它像是这两件事的集大成。疫情期间，我身体有些不适，开始思考自己还剩下多少时间。在职业生涯的这个阶段，我确实觉得自己会为《Physint》倾尽全力。即使那场会议结束后，我仍非常想继续这个项目。当时我在想：「我该怎么办？」

paragraphs.en: Another big thing I thought about is that, I became independent and made my own studio, and a lot of people have done the same. But, no one has been super successful, no matter where they are in the world. But I believe that the trend of this era should be one in which creators can do their own independent projects and become big. But if Kojima Productions collapses, that doesn’t follow this trend at all. It’s a step backwards for indies. So I needed to stand firm and continue this project. My mind went blank, but I decided to think, “Okay, understood,” and became determined to continue Physint in some way.
paragraphs.cn: 我还反复思考了另一件大事：我独立出来创办自己的工作室，很多人也做过同样的事。但无论身处世界何地，都没有人取得过特别巨大的成功。不过，我相信这个时代的趋势，应当是创作者能独立做自己的项目，并把事业做大。但如果小岛工作室倒闭，那就完全不符合这种趋势，对独立开发者而言也是一种倒退。因此，我必须站稳脚跟，继续这个项目。我当时脑中一片空白，但还是告诉自己：「好，我明白了。」随后，我下定决心，无论以什么方式都要继续《Physint》。

paragraphs.en: True story: after the meeting, the first thing I did was, I came back to my desk, and I started to write and add a little bit more to the concept for Physint. What had just happened was a big thing, a big incident. And so I decided to just keep it between the three of us [Hideo Kojima, Shinji Hirano and Aki Saito] for now, and we didn’t tell the staff, because we needed to figure out a direction before telling anyone. So in the next couple of days, we were always thinking about teaming up with first-parties, but I thought maybe we could change directions. Maybe we could team up with third-party or other partners.
paragraphs.cn: 说真的，会议结束后，我做的第一件事就是回到办公桌前，开始撰写《Physint》的概念，并再补充一点内容。刚刚发生的是一件大事，是重大事件。因此，我决定暂时只让我们三人——小岛秀夫、Shinji Hirano和Aki Saito——知道，没有告诉员工，因为我们得先理清方向，才能告诉其他人。接下来的几天里，我们原本一直在考虑与第一方合作，但我觉得或许可以换个方向，也许能与第三方或其他合作伙伴联手。

paragraphs.en: I thought just bringing a pitch of a game title and saying, "Can you fund this?” is a very old-fashioned way of doing things… Instead, I thought that the way to go was to say, “I'm making this new IP, and I want to consider everything like movies, dramas, anime, TV, comics, music. Let's create a new IP with all of this included." I was thinking about who to pitch to, and I was thinking of not just the game industry, but the movie industry, movie studios, and also streaming companies and things like that. Because in the end, I think because we're all digital, these industries are all coming together with games in some form.
paragraphs.cn: 我觉得，仅仅带着一款游戏的企划去提案，然后问「你们能为它提供资金吗？」已经是很老派的做法了……相反，我认为应该这样说：「我正在打造一个新IP，并希望把电影、电视剧、动画、电视节目、漫画和音乐等一切都纳入考虑。让我们把这些全都包括进来，共同打造一个新IP。」我当时在想该向谁提案，目标不应只限于游戏行业，也该包括电影业、电影制片厂，以及流媒体公司等。因为归根结底，我认为正是由于大家都已数字化，这些行业正以某种形式与游戏融合。

paragraphs.en: So I started approaching people and everyone had positive reactions, so I had a good feeling about it. But I also thought, it's not just the money we needed. We also needed technical support, marketing support, holding playtests and things like that. And we can't do this all internally. So I was thinking, who could support all this?
paragraphs.cn: 于是我开始联络一些人，大家的反应都很积极，这让我感觉不错。但我也意识到，我们需要的不只是资金，还需要技术支持、营销支持，以及组织试玩测试等帮助。这些事不可能全靠内部完成，所以我开始思考，谁能提供这些支持？

paragraphs.en: I approached Xbox and they were great. They could support us technically. And also we've been working on OD with them, so we already had a connection. I made a proper pitch of Physint to them. And then their first reaction was like, "This pitch was fantastic. Never seen a pitch like this!" And that's how it started with Xbox.
paragraphs.cn: 我找到了XBOX，他们非常支持我们，能提供技术方面的帮助。而且我们一直在和他们合作开发《OD》，彼此本来就有联系。我向他们正式提案了《Physint》。他们的第一反应是：「这个提案太棒了，从没见过这样的提案！」就这样，我们和XBOX开始了合作。

paragraphs.en: I couldn't tell my staff until we decided on a new partner. But three days after the meeting with SIE, I called the leaders of the Physint team, and I explained the situation to them. But I also said, "I'm going to go find a new partner, so don't worry." But at the same time, because of the cancellation of the project, I had to make the Physint team smaller and move some people to the OD team.
paragraphs.cn: 在敲定新合作伙伴前，我不能告诉员工这件事。但在和SIE会面三天后，我召集了《Physint》团队的负责人，向他们说明情况。我也告诉他们：「我会去找新的合作伙伴，所以别担心。」不过，由于项目被取消，我不得不缩减《Physint》团队，并把一些人调到《OD》团队。

paragraphs.en: And then the following week, I was very worried. I thought people would leave. But I had told them to create material for a pitch for Physint. And when I went into work the following week, very worried they might not be motivated, I went to go see the team, and they were happily creating this pitch for me and having a great time. So I thought, wow, I have really tough people here. So I was really happy about that. I was surprised.
paragraphs.cn: 接下来的一周，我非常担心，觉得可能会有人离开。但我已经让他们为《Physint》准备提案材料。第二周我去上班时，仍担心他们会不会失去干劲，于是去看了团队的情况。结果他们正兴高采烈地帮我准备提案，做得很开心。我当时想，哇，这里的人真的很坚韧。这让我非常高兴，也很意外。

paragraphs.en: And then we've been just negotiating with Xbox. And the Physint team still exists and we're continuing to experiment with the game. And before the announcement yesterday, we disclosed internally to all staff, and it was quite calm. Everyone received it very well. So that was a happy surprise too. So it's calm internally. They were like, "Oh, we can still work on it, so that's great! Okay."
paragraphs.cn: 之后我们便一直在和XBOX谈判。《Physint》团队仍然存在，我们也继续在游戏上做实验。在昨天公布消息前，我们已向全体员工内部说明，现场相当平静。大家都很接受这个结果，这也是一个令人高兴的意外。工作室内部目前很平静，大家的反应是：「哦，我们还能继续做，那太好了！好。」

paragraphs.en: IGN: When you moved staff to OD, did they come back later? Did you lose any staff?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：调到《OD》团队的员工后来回来了吗？你们有没有失去员工？

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: No. I predicted that people might leave, but no one did. For example, the OD team could’ve said, "Oh, we don't want the Physint team!” because the Physint team is made up of old veterans. That's a joke, of course! But anyway, we're actually doing very well internally.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：没有。我原本预计可能会有人离开，但实际上没有一个人走。比如《OD》团队的人本可以说：「哦，我们不想要《Physint》团队！」毕竟《Physint》团队里都是些资深老将。当然，这只是个玩笑！但总之，我们内部的情况其实很好。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Did production stop at any point?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：制作过程有没有在某个阶段停下来？

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: So the work didn’t stop. I'm still doing the concept. How I create the game is a little unique. The world, the game system, scenario, the visuals, the design, modeling, I'm still doing that. I'm still casting and also doing scans for the actors. But the game system for the new technology, like enemy AI and stuff, I'm still experimenting on all of this. I have to change the story depending on how the game experiment works. So it's not like we're ready to go, or like it's like a big team already. It's more like a very small team that remained for the crucial parts, and all the others moved to OD.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：工作没有停。我现在仍在负责概念设计。我制作游戏的方式有点特别，世界观、游戏系统、剧本、视觉效果、设计和建模，这些都还是我在做。我也仍在选角，并为演员进行扫描。至于新技术相关的游戏系统，例如敌人AI之类，我还在不断实验。我必须根据游戏实验的结果调整故事。所以项目并不是已经准备就绪，也还没有组建起大团队。目前留在《Physint》项目的只是负责关键部分的一小支团队，其他人都转去《OD》了。

paragraphs.en: There wasn’t much of a delay or anything because it was a very minor change. Of course, if I had a full team on the Physint project, it would be faster. But the animation team is mainly on OD. But the animation, the motion, and things like that will of course change later to the actor’s movements, once we start doing performance capture. So right now, it's in there for the sake of experimenting. I'm working on it every day still.
paragraphs.cn: 这次调整很小，所以没有造成太多延期之类的问题。当然，如果《Physint》项目有完整团队，开发速度会更快。不过，动画团队主要在负责《OD》。而等到我们开始进行动作捕捉后，动画、动作等内容当然都会改为演员的实际动作。目前加入这些内容只是为了实验。我每天仍在推进这项工作。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Did you have to change the engine or anything like that (is it Decima?)?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：你是否必须更换引擎或做类似调整？现在用的是Decima吗？

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: Well, I haven't really decided yet. I'm still experimenting.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：这个我其实还没有决定，仍在实验。

paragraphs.en: After we decided to team up with Xbox, they said they will give us a lot of technological support. When I went to visit them during the Don Mattrick days, they had so many labs and everything, and they were experimenting on so many things, like state of the art, new, really new, cutting-edge technology. I was really surprised. I was thinking, “There are so many Doc Browns from Back to the Future here!” So I want to use all this new technology. Anything that I can use, I want to use, and I'm looking forward to teaming up with Xbox, but I really haven't decided about the engine.
paragraphs.cn: 「我们决定与XBOX合作后，他们表示会为我们提供大量技术支持。Don Mattrick在任期间，我去拜访过他们。当时那里有许多实验室和各种设施，他们还在试验大量最先进、全新且真正尖端的技术，这让我非常惊讶。我当时心想：‘这里有这么多《回到未来》里的布朗博士！’所以我想用上所有这些新技术。只要能用，我就想用。我很期待与XBOX合作，不过引擎方面还没有作出决定。」

paragraphs.en: IGN: You wrote on X that you found a “common vision” with Xbox — what was that vision?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：「你曾在X上写道，你与XBOX找到了‘共同愿景’——那是什么愿景？」

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: The biggest thing was, they're not thinking of just funding a game. They're thinking about movies and anime. It's more about the IP. Let's create a new IP. And that's bigger in scale, so to speak. And not many other game publishers or game developers have that kind of vision.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：「最关键的是，他们考虑的不只是为一款游戏提供资金，也包括电影和动画，更着眼于IP本身。我们要创造一个全新的IP。可以说，这个构想的规模更大。其他游戏发行商或开发商中，拥有这种愿景的并不多。」

paragraphs.en: I haven't talked to them specifically, but Nintendo is doing something similar for Mario and Zelda with movies, attractions, and things like that. But I think that's how Xbox sees it as well. Because it's not the era of just game consoles. You create an IP, and it can be a game or a movie or music, and everything comes together. You can expand it to merchandising, too. And probably the next thing will be AR and stuff, and that would really affect our everyday lives in the future. And Nintendo has found great success with Super Mario at Universal Studios, with live attractions. So I think they were thinking of all this, probably. And I thought that really matches my vision of the future.
paragraphs.cn: 「我没有就此和他们具体谈过，不过任天堂正围绕马力欧和塞尔达做类似的事，例如电影、游乐设施等。但我认为，XBOX也是这么看待这件事的。因为如今早已不是只靠游戏主机的时代了。你打造出一个IP后，它可以延伸为游戏、电影或音乐，所有内容都会汇聚在一起。还可以扩展到周边商品。接下来或许会是AR等技术，而这将真正影响我们未来的日常生活。任天堂在环球影城打造的《超级马力欧》实景游乐设施已经取得巨大成功。所以我想，他们大概也把这些都考虑进去了。我觉得这与我对未来的愿景非常契合。」

paragraphs.en: IGN: OD was commissioned under Phil Spencer, but how were the discussions with Asha Sharma and her team this time?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：「《OD》是在菲尔·斯宾塞任内委托开发的，那么这次你与Asha Sharma及其团队的沟通如何？」

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: Well Phil, I had a long relationship with him. He’s like a buddy, right? Just like Mr. Ken Kutaragi. I was sad when Phil retired, and at that time, I didn't know Asha very well yet. I went to Redmond back in April, and I talked with her. She is quite young, but we kind of clicked, and I felt that she was going to be a promising CEO. So that's the feeling I got. That was back in April. And then I felt like it was going to be a new Xbox. It's not just a changing of the CEOs, it was more like the structure. And I think that they're looking and envisioning the future, probably.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：「菲尔和我相识已久。他算是我的老朋友，就像久多良木健先生一样。菲尔退休时，我很难过；当时我对Asha还不太了解。4月时，我去了一趟雷德蒙德，和她聊了聊。她很年轻，但我们很投缘，我觉得她会成为一位前途可期的CEO。这是我当时的感受。那是在4月。之后，我感觉XBOX会焕然一新。这不只是CEO的更替，更像是组织架构发生了变化。我想，他们大概正着眼于未来，也在构想未来。」

paragraphs.en: With @asha_shar pic.twitter.com/fhQuHOqE5u
paragraphs.cn: 与@asha_shar合影pic.twitter.com/fhQuHOqE5u

paragraphs.en: IGN: Xbox first-party games are sometimes also multiplatform. Will Physint still come out on PlayStation?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：XBOX的第一方游戏有时也会登陆多个平台。《Physint》还会登陆PlayStation吗？

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: I don’t know the answer to that – that would be a question for Xbox. But I don't know for sure. In previous updates from Xbox, I thought that they have this kind of stance where they want to deliver to as many gamers as possible, no matter what the platform is. I think all of that will be announced at a later time. I'm not sure yet, and I can't really say.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：「我不知道答案，这该问XBOX。但我也不能确定。XBOX此前的更新让我觉得，他们的立场是想把作品带给尽可能多的玩家，不论平台。我想这些都会在之后公布。我现在还不确定，也确实没法说。」

paragraphs.en: IGN: You said Sony gave no reason for cancelling the game, but did they clarify this later? What was the reason?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：你说索尼没有说明取消游戏的原因，但后来他们澄清过吗？原因是什么？

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: No, not at all. They haven't contacted me ever since. But I'm not fighting with Sony. We're not in a dispute. But what I want to say is that we've been together for 30 years and we have this relationship. So if this was the conclusion, I would've wanted to hear it a little earlier. But that meeting in June, they just gave us the final notice.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：「没有，完全没有。自那以后，他们就再也没有联系过我。但我没有在和索尼对抗，我们之间也没有争端。不过我想说的是，我们已经合作30年了，有这样的关系。如果结论就是这样，我本希望能早点听到这个消息。可在6月那场会议上，他们只是给了我们最终通知。」

paragraphs.en: As I said, my mind went blank, so I didn't really ask a lot of questions. It was more like, what should I do with my company? So that was what was on my mind at the time. I've always been a big Sony fan. I've been using a Walkman. All my cameras are Sony. So I have no bad feelings towards them.
paragraphs.cn: 「就像我说的，我当时脑子一片空白，没怎么追问。满脑子想的都是，我的公司该怎么办？我一直是索尼的忠实粉丝，一直在用Walkman，所有相机也都是索尼的。所以我并不怨恨他们。」

paragraphs.en: IGN: Who from Sony told you they were pulling funding? Was it Hermen Hulst?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：「索尼方面是谁告诉你，他们要撤回资助？是Hermen Hulst吗？」

paragraphs.en: Hideo Kojima: I can’t say. You would have to ask them.
paragraphs.cn: 小岛秀夫：「我不能说。你得去问他们。」

paragraphs.en: IGN: Was there ever a time when you lost confidence in Physint? What was your lowest ebb?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：「你有没有一度对《Physint》失去信心？你最低谷的时期是什么时候？」
